desc: Read input N, sequence A, and sequence B.
Identify indices where both A[i] and B[i] are not -1.
Check if all such pairs have the same sum. If not, print "No".
If there are fully known pairs, let $S$ be their sum. Iterate through all elements: if $A[i]$ is known, check $A[i] \le S$; if $B[i]$ is known, check $B[i] \le S$. If any check fails, print "No".
If no fully known pairs exist, print "Yes".
